summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-8 reverse share split of its ordinary shares. The Company's issued and outstanding shares will decrease from 8,332,518 to approximately 1,041,565, with fractional shares rounded to the nearest whole share. The par value will adjust from NIS 1.80 to NIS 14.40 per share, and authorized share capital will be 112,500,000 shares. Trading on Nasdaq will commence at the adjusted price on August 19, 2026. Outstanding warrants and options will have proportionate adjustments to exercise price and share count. This corporate action is not a special situation; no strategic transaction or event warranting categorization is present. A new CUSIP number, M47238205, will apply post-split.
